plugin.note: Mammoths have no elemental weakness and negligible defensive bonuses, so any strong weapon works. Use low-risk Wilderness gear such as Viggora's chainmace and keep a one-click escape teleport ready.

requirements: A one-click teleport for emergency escape
mechanics: Mammoths use a stab melee attack with a max hit of about 7.
Mammoths have no elemental weakness and very low defensive bonuses.
All Krystilia mammoth kills must occur in the Wilderness south-east of Ferox Enclave.

methods.label: General strategy
methods.summary: Kill Wilderness mammoths with any strong melee weapon and low-risk gear.
steps: Bring only low-risk gear and a one-click escape teleport.
Travel to the Wilderness south-east of Ferox Enclave.
Kill mammoths quickly; their negligible defence means gear choice matters less than survivability.
Watch the minimap for player killers and teleport if threatened.
notes: Ferox Enclave offers a safe restock and re-entry point nearby.
Mammoths give solid Slayer XP (130) per kill for a low-level Wilderness task.

methods.label: Ranged from distance
methods.summary: Range mammoths to stay mobile near the Ferox Enclave escape.
recommendedFor: players who prefer distance in the Wilderness
staying near a fast Ferox Enclave escape
requiredOrKeyItems: Craw's bow or another strong ranged weapon
steps: Travel to the Wilderness south-east of Ferox Enclave.
Attack mammoths from distance with a strong ranged weapon.
Keep moving toward Ferox Enclave if player killers approach.
Teleport or dip into Ferox Enclave to escape when threatened.
notes: Mammoths have no elemental weakness, so any accurate style works.
Ranged keeps you mobile for a quick escape to Ferox Enclave.
